test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Water and minerals __presented to the soil__ are absorbed by the roots..
solution:
The correct answer is Present in the soil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the above sentence there should be** present in the soil instead of presented to the soil.**
 
• The word **in** means (used to indicate location) within or to a position within a specific space or object.

*Example* : Bottle is **in** my bag.

 
• The word **To** means as far as; in the direction of.

*Example* : Spatula is used **to** mix.

 
• To make a verb's past tense or past participle, **the suffix "-ed" is added.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The above sentence is of present tense, **hence -ed will not be used in it.**

Tenses Chart

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Tenses

 
 
 
Rules and Formula

 
 
 

 
 
Simple Present Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Verb in the base form/third person plural form + the rest of the sentence

 
 
 

 
 
Present Continuous Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Helping Verb(am/is/are) + Main verb + ing + the rest of the sentence 

 
 
 

 
 
Present Perfect Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Helping Verb (have/has) + Past participle of the main verb + the rest of the sentence along with the time frame

 
 
 

 
 
Present Perfect Continuous Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Have/Has + Been + Verb+ ing + the rest of the sentence

 
 
 

 
 
Simple Past Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Verb + ed / verb in the past tense + the rest of the sentence

 
 
 

 
 
Past Continuous Tense 

 
 
 
Subject + Helping Verb(was/were) + Main verb + ing + the rest of the sentence

 
 
 

 
 
Past Perfect Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Helping Verb (had) + Past participle of the main verb + the rest of the sentence along with the time frame.

 
 
 

 
 
Past Perfect Continuous Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Had + Been + Verb + ing + the rest of the sentence

 
 
 

 
 
Simple Future Tense

 
 
 
Subject + will/shall + V1 + Object

 
 
 

 
 
Future Continuous Tense

 
 
 
Subject + will be/shall be + V1 + ing + Object

 
 
 

 
 
Future Perfect Tense

 
 
 
Subject + will have/shall have + V3 + Object

 
 
 

 
 
Future Perfect Continuous Tense

 
 
 
Subject + will have been + V1 + ing + Object
